title: HushSpec Core v1
description: Schema for HushSpec Core 1.x documents, which also accepts the frozen 0.x lineage (core spec 2.2). Validates portable, engine-neutral AI agent security rules.

hushspec.description: HushSpec document format version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. The 0.x and 1.x lineages are accepted; an engine supporting minor X.Y accepts every X.Y.Z (core spec 2.2).

name.description: Policy name. When present it must not be empty: bundle subjects and receipt policy summaries carry it (core spec 2).

extends.description: Reference to a base policy. Resolution is engine-specific.

merge_strategy.description: Strategy for merging with the base policy.

ForbiddenPaths.description: Block access to sensitive filesystem paths.

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

exceptions.description: Glob patterns that override pattern matches.

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

read.description: Glob patterns allowed for read access.

write.description: Glob patterns allowed for write access.

patch.description: Glob patterns allowed for patch operations. If empty, falls back to write.

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

block.description: Domain glob patterns to block. Block takes precedence over allow.

default.description: Default decision when no pattern matches.

SecretPattern.description: A named regex pattern for secret detection.

pattern.description: Regular expression to match against content, in the HushSpec regex profile (core spec 3.14.3).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this detects.

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

patterns.description: Named regex patterns for secret detection. Names must be unique.

skip_paths.description: Glob patterns of paths to skip scanning.

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

max_additions.description: Maximum number of added lines permitted.

max_deletions.description: Maximum number of deleted lines permitted.

forbidden_patterns.description: Regex patterns forbidden in patch content, in the HushSpec regex profile (core spec 3.14.3).

max_imbalance_ratio.description: Maximum ratio of additions to deletions (or vice versa).

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

forbidden_patterns.description: Regex patterns forbidden in shell commands, in the HushSpec regex profile (core spec 3.14.3).

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

block.description: Tool name blocklist. Block takes precedence.

default.description: Default decision when no list matches.

max_args_size.description: Maximum argument payload size in bytes.

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).
Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).
Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

require_postcondition_probe.description: Whether postcondition verification is required after input injection.

BrowserAutomation.description: Fine-grained controls for browser-automation tool calls: domain allowlist, verb allowlist, and credential detection in type actions.

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

allowed_domains.description: Hosts the agent may navigate to. Supports exact match and *.suffix wildcards.

blocked_domains.description: Hosts that are always denied (evaluated before the allowlist).

allowed_verbs.description: Verbs (actions) the agent may issue. Empty means any verb.

credential_detection.description: Check type/input action values for credential-shaped secrets.

extra_credential_patterns.description: Extra credential regex patterns layered on top of the built-in detectors, in the HushSpec regex profile (core spec 3.14.3).

CodeExecution.description: Restrictions for sandboxed interpreter actions: language allowlist, dangerous module denylist, network gating, and execution-time bounds.

when.description: Condition gating whether this block is active (core spec 3.13).

language_allowlist.description: Allowed interpreter languages (e.g. python, javascript). Empty means any language.

module_denylist.description: Module names whose imports or uses in the code body are denied (word-boundary literal matches).

network_access.description: Permit code-execution calls that request network access.

max_scan_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of code to scan for module detection.

Condition.description: Conditional rule-block gate (core spec 3.13). Present fields are combined with AND. Parsers MUST also reject nesting deeper than 8 levels.

context.description: Dot-delimited runtime-context paths matched against the given values. Comparison is type-sensitive and numbers compare exactly. A scalar matches an equal scalar, or membership in an array at that path; an array matches when it shares at least one element with the value at that path.

any_of.description: At least one sub-condition must hold; an empty array is treated as absent.

not.description: The sub-condition must not hold. Unevaluable when the sub-condition is unevaluable (the block stays active).

capability.description: The effective posture state must grant this capability. Unevaluable (the block stays active) when the policy has no posture extension.

RateCondition.description: Compares an engine-supplied counter (runtime context `counters`) with a threshold. Unevaluable (the block stays active) when the counter is absent; HushSpec never stores state.

counter.description: Counter name in the runtime context's `counters` map.

TimeWindow.description: Daily time window; half-open [start, end), wrapping midnight when start > end.

timezone.description: IANA time zone identifier or fixed offset (+HH:MM / -HH:MM).

days.description: Days on which the window applies (case-insensitive abbreviations); defaults to all days.

Extensions.description: Extension modules for optional capabilities beyond core rules.
Extensions.$comment: Each extension key is validated by its companion schema, referenced by that schema's own $id. The three companion documents are embedded verbatim at the end of $defs, so every reference resolves with no network access and an unknown key inside an extension block is rejected here exactly as it is by the companion schema on its own. `unevaluatedProperties` keeps that closed even if a companion root ever stops setting `additionalProperties: false`.

posture.description: Stateful capability and budget management, as defined by the posture companion schema.

origins.description: Origin-aware policy profiles, as defined by the origins companion schema.

detection.description: Detection engine thresholds and configuration, as defined by the detection companion schema.

GovernanceMetadata.description: Optional governance metadata for enterprise policy lifecycle management. Has no impact on evaluation.

author.description: Identity of the policy author (e.g., email, team name).

approval_date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the policy was approved.

classification.description: Data classification level of the policy.

change_ticket.description: Change management reference (e.g., JIRA ticket, ServiceNow ID).

lifecycle_state.description: Current lifecycle state of the policy.

effective_date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the policy becomes effective.

expiry_date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the policy expires.

owner.description: Identity accountable for the policy over its lifetime (e.g., a team or distribution list). Distinct from 'author', who wrote this revision.

reviewers.description: Identities who reviewed the policy. Advisory only; separation of duties is checked by tooling, never by an engine.

next_review_date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the policy is due for its next review.

changelog.description: Revision history, newest first. Declarative only: entries never influence evaluation.

supersedes.description: The 'policy_version' this document replaces. A document MUST NOT supersede its own version.

controls.description: Compliance control mappings for this policy. Declarative only: mappings never influence evaluation.

ControlMapping.description: Maps one compliance control onto the parts of this document that implement it. Advisory metadata: it has no effect on evaluation.

framework.description: Framework identifier, e.g. 'hipaa-2013' or 'soc2-tsc-2017'. Registered ids and their control-id patterns are listed in spec/registries/frameworks.yaml; unregistered ids are valid but are flagged by linters.

control_id.description: Control identifier within the framework, e.g. '164.312(e)(1)' or 'CC6.1'. Each registered framework declares a control_id_pattern.

rule_paths.description: Dot paths into the resolved document that implement the control. Grammar: path = root *( "." segment ) [ selector ]; root = "rules" / "extensions"; segment = 1*( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" ); selector = "[" 1*( %x20-5A / %x5C / %x5E-7E ) "]" (any character except '[' and ']'). A selector names a list entry by its 'name' or 'id' field. Examples: 'rules' (the whole rules object), 'rules.egress' (one rule block), 'rules.egress.allow' (one field), 'rules.secret_patterns.patterns[ssn]' (one named secret pattern), 'extensions.posture'.

notes.description: Free-text rationale explaining how the mapped paths satisfy the control.

ChangelogEntry.description: One revision of the policy. Advisory metadata: it has no effect on evaluation.

version.description: The 'policy_version' this entry describes, as a string.

date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the revision was made.

PostureExtension.title: HushSpec Posture Extension v1
PostureExtension.description: Schema for the HushSpec Posture extension. Declares a state machine for capability and budget management.

initial.description: Initial state name. Must reference a key in states.

states.description: Named states in the posture state machine.

transitions.description: Transitions between states, triggered by events.

PostureState.description: A named state in the posture state machine.

capabilities.description: Capability identifiers available in this state. Standard values: file_access, file_write, egress, shell, tool_call, patch, custom.

budgets.description: Budget limits keyed by budget key. Standard keys: file_writes, egress_calls, shell_commands, tool_calls, patches, custom_calls.

from.description: Source state name, or "*" to match any state.

to.description: Target state name. Must not be "*".

after.description: Duration string. Required when trigger is "timeout". Format: <number><unit> where unit is s, m, h, or d.

OriginsExtension.title: HushSpec Origins Extension v1
OriginsExtension.description: Schema for the HushSpec Origins extension. Declares origin-aware policy projection for multi-source agent workflows.

default_behavior.description: Behavior when no profile matches. "deny" blocks unmatched origins; "minimal_profile" proceeds under base policy.

profiles.description: Origin profiles, each with match criteria and policy overrides.

OriginProfile.description: An origin profile that narrows the base policy for matching requests.

posture.description: Initial posture state for this origin. Must reference a state in extensions.posture.states.

OriginMatch.description: Criteria for matching an incoming request to this profile.

provider.description: Source provider. Standard values: slack, teams, github, jira, email, discord, webhook, custom.

space_id.description: Channel, room, or repository identifier. Highest priority match field.

space_type.description: Type of space the request originated from.

visibility.description: Visibility level of the source space.

external_participants.description: Whether external participants are present in the source space.

tags.description: Tags that must ALL be present on the source (AND semantics).

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity classification of the source context.

actor_role.description: Role of the requesting actor (e.g., admin, member, guest).

ToolAccessRule.description: Tool access overrides for this origin. Composes with base rules.tool_access via intersection (allow) and union (block).

allow.description: Tool name allowlist. Intersected with base allowlist.

block.description: Tool name blocklist. Unioned with base blocklist.

require_confirmation.description: Tools requiring user/operator approval. Unioned with base list.

default.description: Default decision. If either base or origin specifies "block", effective default is "block".

max_args_size.description: Maximum argument payload size in bytes. The smaller of base and origin applies.

EgressRule.description: Egress overrides for this origin. Composes with base rules.egress via intersection (allow) and union (block).

allow.description: Domain allowlist. Intersected with base allowlist.

block.description: Domain blocklist. Unioned with base blocklist.

default.description: Default decision. If either base or origin specifies "block", effective default is "block".

DataPolicy.description: Data handling controls for this origin context.

allow_external_sharing.description: Whether content may be shared outside the origin context.

redact_before_send.description: Whether sensitive content must be redacted before output.

block_sensitive_outputs.description: Whether outputs containing sensitive patterns are blocked.

OriginBudgets.description: Budget overrides for this origin. The smaller of base and origin values applies.

egress_calls.description: Maximum number of outbound network requests.

shell_commands.description: Maximum number of shell command executions.

allow_cross_origin.description: Whether cross-origin data flow is permitted.

allowed_targets.description: Specific destinations permitted for cross-origin data flow.

require_approval.description: Whether cross-origin flows require user/operator approval.

BridgeTarget.description: A permitted destination for cross-origin data flow.

tags.description: Required tags on the target (AND semantics).

visibility.description: Required visibility level of the target.

DetectionExtension.title: HushSpec Detection Extension v1
DetectionExtension.description: Schema for the HushSpec Detection extension. Declares thresholds and configuration for content analysis guards.

Level.description: Detection severity level, ordered: safe < suspicious < high < critical.

enabled.description: Whether prompt injection detection is active.

warn_at_or_above.description: Minimum detection level that produces a warning.

block_at_or_above.description: Minimum detection level that produces a denial.

max_scan_bytes.description: Maximum input size to scan, in bytes.

PromptInjectionHeuristics.description: Configuration of the normative heuristic_injection@1 detector (detection spec 3.5).

enabled.description: Whether the heuristic detector runs alongside the regex detector.

min_score.description: Integer scores below this floor are reported as 0 (no signal).

block_threshold.description: Risk score (0-100) at or above which input is denied.

warn_threshold.description: Risk score (0-100) at or above which a warning is produced.

max_input_bytes.description: Maximum input size to scan, in bytes.

enabled.description: Whether threat intelligence screening is active.

pattern_db.description: Path to pattern database file or "builtin:<name>" for engine-bundled databases.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum similarity score (0.0-1.0) for a pattern match to be considered a finding.

top_k.description: Number of top matches to include in evaluation evidence.
